# What will my Self Assessment bill be on 31 January?

> Free UK Self Assessment tax calculator for 2025/26: combine employment, self-employed profit, rental income, savings and dividends. See income tax, Class 4 NIC, student loan, the 31 January bill and your payments on account. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it covers

- Income tax in HMRC order (non-savings, savings, dividends), with the personal allowance taper, starting rate for savings, Personal Savings Allowance and Dividend Allowance.
- Self-employed profit after the trading allowance or actual expenses, whichever is larger. Property profit takes the property allowance or actual expenses with the 20% mortgage-interest credit, whichever gives the lower bill.
- Class 4 National Insurance, student loan and Postgraduate Loan. Unearned income of £2,000 or less is left out of student loan, and Plan 5 collects nothing for 2025/26.
- The 31 January balance after PAYE, payments on account, and what a further £1,000 pension contribution or Gift Aid donation would save.
- Not covered: Scotland, capital gains, losses, foreign income, the marriage allowance, the High Income Child Benefit Charge.
